## Endpoints

### GET /api/v1/sessions

Retrieve a list of users.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| page | int | Page number |
| limit | int | Items per page |

**Example Response:**

```json
{
  "users": [
    {"id": 1, "name": "久保 裕貴"},
    {"id": 2, "name": "石田貴久"}

  "total": 333
}
```

Create a new user.

```json
{
  "name": "島崎 さやが",
  "email": "eito@example.net"
}
```
